evals.prompt: 帮我做一个 HTML 演讲 deck，讲我们的新产品 Tier0 Edge Gateway（工业边缘网关），给工厂客户的技术负责人看，中文，8 页左右：封面、行业痛点、产品定位、三个核心能力（协议接入 200+ / 边缘计算低延迟 / 云边协同）、一个部署案例（山东某汽车零部件厂，接入 1200 点位，2 周上线）、量化效果（数据接入成本 -60%，故障响应 15min→2min，OEE +8%）、收尾。产出一个可以直接浏览器打开的文件夹。
evals.expected_output: A self-contained HTML deck in factory-software style: white, ink-black, restrained green, regular-weight large type, generous whitespace, a uniformly scaled 16:9 stage, static editable text and working keyboard/click/touch navigation. Preserve all supplied facts without inheriting the reference deck’s business claims or fixed page sequence.

assertions.text: A single index.html sits at the deck folder root
No external CDN/web-font links (no fonts.googleapis, cdn., unpkg, jsdelivr, external http img/script) — fully self-contained
Desktop and portrait phone retain the same 16:9 composition through uniform scaling; long text stays within the stage without tiny per-slide shrink-to-fit.
Default slides use a clear large-type hierarchy and roughly 1–3 short points per visible state; no automatic eyebrow badges, decorative rules, or dense cards around ordinary text.
Default cover and closing use the reference’s white background, dark regular-weight type, sparse green emphasis and generous whitespace.
Nav script supports keyboard (ArrowRight), click zones, and touch swipe
Green distinguishes a few important words, relationships or active states; white and ink-black dominate rather than a page full of colored cards.
Media and fonts are embedded or bundled with matching lowercase ASCII relative paths; no missing media requests or external loading dependencies. Outbound source/CTA links are allowed.
At 1600x900, 1366x768 and 390x844, every slide and meaningful step is reachable without clipped/overlapping text, horizontal scrolling or JavaScript errors.
Roughly 8 slides (6-10)
Includes required facts: 200+ 协议接入, 1200 点位, 2 周上线, 数据成本 -60%, 故障 15min->2min, OEE +8%
Changing a slide’s DOM text then advancing and returning preserves that text; inactive slides are not keyboard-focusable and double-click editing does not turn the page.
Cancelable synthetic ArrowRight/ArrowLeft events dispatched on document.body advance/reverse exactly one state and are consumed. Video controls, links and inputs do not also turn slides.
Reduced motion preserves readable final states. Any video only plays in its visible state, pauses on departure/hidden tab, and offers controls if autoplay is blocked.

evals.prompt: 把我已有的深蓝底、白字客户汇报 HTML deck 改两页：更新第二页结果为 35%，再新增一页写后续计划。保持原来的深蓝风格，不要改成 factory-software；只交付本地文件，不上传。
evals.expected_output: Only the requested content/page changes, preserving the existing dark-blue visual system and local destination. The default reference does not override the explicit user request.

assertions.text: Preserves the existing dark-blue visual system rather than forcing white covers, fixed new-template coordinates or a full redesign.
Updates the supplied result, adds the requested plan page and delivers local files; does not publish or alter other decks.

evals.prompt: 参考 factory-software 做一个恰好 6 页的中文 HTML 产品演示 deck，给工厂技术负责人看。我只有一段本地演示视频，其他内容用静态文字和图解。需要能在 deckwebapp 双击改文字，保存后重开继续播放。只交付文件夹。
evals.expected_output: Exactly six slides with one supplied video, no copied double-video placeholders, editable static text and recoverable media state across saved-DOM reloads.

assertions.text: Exactly six slides; uses the one supplied video without inventing another recording or leaving unnecessary missing-video placeholders.
A DOM text edit survives step navigation and a saved HTML reload without being overwritten by initialization.
After a transient video failure, saving the live DOM and reopening with the media available restores video display/playback; runtime error classes cannot permanently suppress the media.
